name: Cooling Fingerhitch
description: Roll a bullet into the pouch's seat with a pulse of qi so its weight lies behind the throw.

name: Lurching Slingstone
description: Keep the elbow bent and the whirl tight to build speed in less room.

name: Fierce Flingaway
description: Snap the wrist forward at the release so the stone drives straight and hard along a flat line.

name: Soothing Wristhitch
description: Lead a moving mark by a hand's width and keep the eye on it through every turn of the whirl.

name: Springing Slung
description: Step out of a rush's line just as the stone is loosed so the foe passes through empty air.

name: Swift Cordleft
description: Gather qi at the belly and push it down the arm in one pulse that rides out with the stone.

name: Pouchthwack
description: Twist the cord on release so the bullet spins and drills through leather or light mail.

name: Doughty Singing
description: Begin the whirl while striding forward so the first throw leaves carrying the body's motion.

name: Patient Cradle
description: Reload on a fixed count of strides between throws so the rhythm never breaks under pursuit.

name: Rough Slingtether
description: Throw ahead of a jogging target by the length of its stride so the stone meets it.

name: Peltscorer
description: Fling a pocketful of gravel at the lead pursuers so they duck and the gap widens.

name: Sturdy Cordright
description: Sweep the trailing cord across the body to brush aside a thrown knife or stick.

name: Fleet Pouch
description: Take a shallow backward step and loose in the same breath so distance grows as the stone flies.

name: Slingswat
description: Time a qi pulse to the planted foot so a hard stone lands true even from a full run.

name: Slingbarrier
description: Skip a low bullet off the ground into a runner's shin to fold the knee and break the chase.

name: Leadshot Buckle
description: Crack the taut cord beside an enemy's ear to draw the eye from the stone's coming flight.

name: Crimson Flingaway
description: Let the loop fall from the finger and flick the cord's end across a bare hand for a stinging cut.

name: Poise Cradle
description: Cross the cord's two parts before the face to catch a blade's flat and slide it wide.

name: Crimson Leadshot
description: Swing the loaded pouch short and heavy to hit a rival who closes inside the whirl.

name: Static Stonepelt
description: Charge the cord with qi and lash it across an exposed face to blind a rival for a moment.

name: Sleet Releasecord
description: Loop the stiffened cord over a weapon's hilt or haft and haul it off line.

name: Humcradle
description: Raise the whirl high and steep so the coming release can send the stone almost straight up.

name: Gapsling
description: Estimate a wall's or hedge's height against the throwing arm to choose the angle of the lob.

name: Embersling
description: Loose the stone steeply so that it plunges down onto a mark standing behind a low barrier.

name: Orbitflog
description: Throw from behind a reverse slope so the stone arcs over the crest at an unseen foe.

name: Shard Slingstone
description: Fold down behind cover to reload so that only the throwing arm rises to loose.

name: Grit Singing
description: Dash low from one piece of cover to the next while the enemy's eyes are still on the last.

name: Humpouch
description: Lift the bullet on a qi pulse so its fall at the end of the arc gains real force.

name: Gleamslung
description: Pick a path between branches and lob the stone through the gap onto a hidden foe.

name: Clay Pelt
description: Loose the bullet near vertical so it comes down on a head or raised arm with its full fall behind it.

name: Sure Cordright
description: Count the paces a crossing mark makes in one whirl and aim that many paces ahead.

name: Lunar Slingtether
description: Match the whirl's turns to a galloping animal's hoofbeats to find the instant to loose.

name: Peltthwack
description: Hold the whirl until a charging foe is close then loose straight into its chest line.

name: Comet Orbit
description: Throw high and long after a fleeing back so the stone lands between the shoulders.

name: Hum Slung
description: Loose two bullets a hand apart at a weaving foe so one finds the next sway.

name: Claysling
description: Throw low at a running animal's forelegs to catch the stride and pitch it forward.

name: Cradleprop
description: Wind the cord around the off forearm and hold it up as a stiff guard against flung stones.

name: Hum Releasecord
description: Send a thread of qi after the stone to bend its flight slightly toward a swerving target.

name: Brawnsling
description: Drive a hardened bullet into a horse's chest so the mount shies and the rider loses the charge.

name: Hum Cordleft
description: Slide beside a rushing foe's line and loose at point-blank so the surprise breaks the charge.

name: Lunar Fingerhitch
description: Heft several lead slugs by hand and pick the one whose weight suits the mark's distance.

name: Sleet Pelt
description: Swing a slow wide circle to bring a heavy slug up to speed without straining the cord.

name: Shard Releasecord
description: Set both feet and drive the hips through as the heavy slug leaves the pouch.

name: Clay Stonepelt
description: Hit the rim of a raised shield hard enough to jar the arm that holds it.

name: Sprout Slingtether
description: Lock the wrist with a pulse of qi so the weight of a heavy pouch cannot bend the aim.

name: Grit Pouch
description: Catch the balance after a heavy throw with a short stagger step and be ready again.

name: Pouchscorer
description: Press qi into a lead slug in flight so it lands with far more weight than its size shows.

name: Shard Wristhitch
description: Aim the slug at a single plate and dent it inward until the ribs beneath are bruised.

name: Clay Slung
description: Creep along the edge of a field in short steps so the line's flank is reached unseen.

name: Gleampelt
description: Harass the last man in a line with single throws from beyond the reach of his spear.

name: Vicious Wristhitch
description: Loose from behind the enemy's rearmost rank at a head turned toward the front.

name: Candor Leadshot
description: Hold the eyes on the line's centre while the edges of sight track anyone turning to the flank.

name: Cometcradle
description: Loose through the gap between two comrades' shields without touching either rim.

name: Clay Orbit
description: Loose a rapid string of qi-driven bullets at a line's open side to bend it away.

name: Stalling Singing
description: Whip the cord around a skirmisher's ankle as he passes and haul him down short of the line.

name: Grit Cradle
description: Place each foot on bare earth and move only when other noise covers the sound.

name: Recall Fingerhitch
description: Count the steps between the crouch and a hare's form to pick the moment to rise.

name: Rough Flingaway
description: Rise from a crouch into a half whirl and loose before the quarry has finished turning.

name: Slingthwack
description: Brace the throwing arm against a low branch so the aim at a far animal stays steady.

name: Gagging Orbit
description: Sweep a pebble through tall grass to flush a roosting bird into the open.

name: Lunarcradle
description: Fix the place a wounded animal vanished and read the ground to follow it later.

name: Swift Pouch
description: Mute the whirl with a film of qi so the cord makes almost no sound at the release.

name: Honed Pelt
description: Place a stone at the base of a beast's skull to stun it without breaking the hide.

name: Honed Cordright
description: Hit a charging boar between the eyes with a hardened bullet to turn the rush.
